title: Countdown
prompt: start = 3 is given. Print a countdown: 3, 2, 1, then liftoff — a while loop with a decrement.

tests.name: countdown then liftoff
tests.code:
assert printed == ["3", "2", "1", "liftoff"], f"got {printed}"
assert "while" in code, "use a while loop"
tests.hint: while start > 0: print(start); start -= 1 — then print liftoff after the loop.
